description:
Does a RWD Red Bull drift car have what it takes to beat an AWD Lambo in a straight line?!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-0509

It’s time for a drag race with one of the craziest M2s we’ve ever seen!

We’ve got our hands on a Red Bull BMW M2 - and it’s been converted into a drift car! So we’re going to see if a car that’s made for cornering at extreme speed has what it takes to beat a Lamborghini in a straight line!

Does it stand a chance? Let’s take a closer look at the stats…

The Red Bull M2 is powered by a BMW S58 engine. However, rather than having twin turbos, this 3-litre straight-six instead comes with one single (yet massive!) turbo, and the power output has been increased to an incredible 1,100hp and 1,200Nm! All of this power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 5-speed sequential gearbox, and being a drift car, it’s super light, tipping the scales at around 1,400kg.
